items.hi: Sirf BRANCH_MANAGER ya SUPER_ADMIN review kar sakte hain, counting staff khud kabhi nahi.

items.en: On approval, the delta (physicalQty minus expectedQty frozen at the cutoff snapshot) is applied to the CURRENT live balance — never overwritten.
items.hi: Approval par delta (physicalQty minus cutoff-snapshot ka expectedQty) current live balance par apply hota hai — overwrite nahi hota.

items.en: So if a GRN arrived mid-count, that receipt is not erased.
items.hi: Isliye agar count ke beech mein GRN aa gaya ho, to wo receipt mitta nahi.

items.en: Shortfall is drawn FEFO from all batches, even expired ones.
items.hi: Shortfall FEFO order mein sabhi batches se liya jaata hai, expired bhi.

items.en: Surplus creates a new UNKNOWN-expiry batch since the count doesn't know which lot it is.
items.hi: Surplus se naya UNKNOWN-expiry batch banta hai kyunki count ko pata nahi kaunsa lot hai.

items.en: If approval would make stock negative, the system rejects with a 409 error — must reconcile first.
items.hi: Agar approval se stock negative ho jaaye, to system 409 error deta hai — pehle reconcile karna zaroori hai.

example.en: Cutoff snapshot expected balance was 5kg. Physical count found 0kg (shortage). Before approval, a 3kg GRN receipt arrived — live balance is now 8kg. Approval delta is -5kg (0-5), so final balance = 8-5 = 3kg, not 0kg, because delta applies to current balance, not an overwrite.
example.hi: Cutoff snapshot ka expected balance 5kg tha. Physical count mein 0kg mila (shortage). Approval se pehle 3kg ka GRN receipt aa gaya — live balance ab 8kg hai. Approval delta -5kg hai (0-5), to final balance = 8-5 = 3kg, 0kg nahi, kyunki delta current balance par apply hota hai, overwrite nahi.

items.summaryEn: System auto-flags materials below min-level and splits the top-up between internal transfer and external purchase.
items.summaryHi: System automatically unhi materials ko flag karta hai jo min-level se neeche hain, aur top-up ko internal transfer aur external purchase mein split karta hai.

items.en: Click "Preview fresh suggestions" — list shows item, current position/max, suggested qty, "Internal first" (from central warehouse), and "External draft" (remainder as indent).
items.hi: "Preview fresh suggestions" click karo — list mein item, current position/max, suggested qty, "Internal first" (central warehouse se) aur "External draft" (baki indent ke roop mein) dikhta hai.

items.en: Click "Create reviewed requests" — creates an internal requisition if internal qty > 0 and/or a DRAFT purchase indent if external qty > 0.
items.hi: "Create reviewed requests" click karo — internal qty > 0 ho to internal requisition banta hai, aur external qty > 0 ho to DRAFT purchase indent banta hai.

items.en: Both still go through normal approval steps — nothing is auto-approved, auto-ordered, or auto-paid.
items.hi: Dono normal approval steps se guzarte hain — kuch bhi auto-approved, auto-ordered ya auto-paid nahi hota.

items.en: A suggestion only triggers when position is below minimum; the top-up always targets the max level.
items.hi: Suggestion sirf tab trigger hota hai jab position minimum se neeche ho; top-up hamesha max level tak target karta hai.

items.en: "Usable stock" plus non-duplicate inbound supply plus pending request reservations are counted exactly once — no double counting.
items.hi: "Usable stock" plus non-duplicate inbound supply plus pending request reservations exactly ek baar count hote hain — double counting nahi hoti.

items.en: Internal availability is based on "proven" central stock (batch balance and flat warehouse balance must match).
items.hi: Internal availability "proven" central stock par based hai (batch balance aur flat warehouse balance match hone chahiye).

items.en: If there's a reconciliation mismatch, internal availability becomes null and everything routes "external" (fail-safe).
items.hi: Agar reconciliation mismatch ho, to internal availability null ho jaata hai aur sab kuch "external" route hota hai (fail-safe).

items.en: Converting checks a "position fingerprint" — if the position changed meanwhile (new GRN, new transfer), system says "stale, refresh" and won't use the old suggestion.
items.hi: Convert karte waqt "position fingerprint" check hota hai — agar position beech mein change ho gayi (naya GRN, naya transfer), to system "stale, refresh" kehta hai aur purana suggestion use nahi karta.

items.en: An idempotent requestKey prevents duplicate requisition/indent creation on a repeated request.
items.hi: Idempotent requestKey repeated request par duplicate requisition/indent banne se rokta hai.

example.en: "Chicken" max 30kg, current position (usable+inbound) 10kg, min 15kg — so it suggests a 20kg top-up. Central warehouse has 12kg proven stock -> 12kg internal requisition + 8kg external draft indent created.
example.hi: "Chicken" ka max 30kg hai, current position (usable+inbound) 10kg, min 15kg — isliye 20kg top-up suggest hota hai. Central warehouse mein 12kg proven stock hai -> 12kg internal requisition + 8kg external draft indent banta hai.

items.en: Owner (SUPER_ADMIN) opens it, enters approve qty for each line (equal or less than requested), clicks "Approve requisition".

items.en: Fulfillment happens separately — via Warehouse module's "Dispatch Transfer" (for RAW) or Semi-FG dispatch form (for PREPARED), linking to this requisition line.

items.en: If some quantity is still pending and no longer needed, click "Cancel remaining".
items.hi: Agar kuch quantity abhi pending hai aur zaroorat nahi, to "Cancel remaining" click karo.

items.hi: Sirf Owner requisition approve kar sakta hai.

items.en: Approved qty can never exceed requested qty.
items.hi: Approved qty requested qty se kabhi zyada nahi ho sakti.

items.hi: "Cancel remaining" sirf remaining (approved minus already-issued) quantity cancel karta hai — already-dispatched real stock kabhi touch nahi hota.

items.en: When a dispatch fulfills this requisition line, the system checks that total dispatched never exceeds approved qty, even across multiple dispatches.
items.hi: Jab koi dispatch requisition line fulfill karta hai, system check karta hai ki total dispatched approved qty se zyada na ho, multiple dispatches mein bhi.

example.en: Branch "Andheri" requested 10kg "Gravy Base" (Prepared). Owner approved 7kg. Base kitchen dispatched 4kg first, then 3kg (total 7kg = fully fulfilled). If now 1kg more is attempted, system rejects ("would exceed approved quantity").

items.hi: Warehouses tab par jao, central warehouse select karo.

items.hi: "Record central stock-in" click karo.

items.hi: Unknown expiry (na date, na "non-expiring") HELD rehta hai — Owner verify kiye bina consumption/FEFO dispatch ke liye eligible nahi.

items.hi: "Owner verified non-expiring" sirf SUPER_ADMIN ke liye hai aur evidence zaroori hai.

items.en: Central warehouse's flat balance (warehouseStock) and its real batch-lots total must always reconcile — if mismatched, internal availability becomes "unknown" (also affects reorder suggestions).
items.hi: Central warehouse ka flat balance (warehouseStock) aur real batch-lots total hamesha reconcile hona chahiye — mismatch hone par internal availability "unknown" ho jaati hai (reorder suggestions bhi affect hoti hain).

items.summaryEn: Sending raw material from central warehouse to a branch warehouse — only Central-to-Branch is supported.
items.summaryHi: Central warehouse se branch warehouse ko raw material bhejna — sirf Central-to-Branch supported hai.

items.en: Click "Dispatch Transfer".
items.hi: "Dispatch Transfer" click karo.

items.en: Choose "From (Central)" and "To (Branch)" warehouse — branch user can only select their own branch's warehouse; Owner can dispatch to any branch.
items.hi: "From (Central)" aur "To (Branch)" warehouse choose karo — branch user sirf apni branch ka warehouse select kar sakta hai; Owner kisi bhi branch ko dispatch kar sakta hai.

items.en: Enter raw material and qty dispatched, click "Dispatch".
items.hi: Raw material aur qty dispatched enter karo, "Dispatch" click karo.

items.en: Only Central-to-Branch transfer is supported; branch-to-branch is not yet available.
items.hi: Sirf Central-to-Branch transfer supported hai; branch-to-branch abhi available nahi.

items.en: Dispatch selects eligible lots via FEFO — expired/HELD/unknown-expiry stock is automatically blocked, never used.
items.hi: Dispatch FEFO se eligible lots select karta hai — expired/HELD/unknown-expiry stock automatically block ho jaata hai, kabhi use nahi hota.

items.en: Central warehouse's flat balance is atomically debited at dispatch time — if insufficient stock, the whole transaction rolls back (no partial transfer is ever created).
items.hi: Central warehouse ka flat balance dispatch ke time atomically debit hota hai — stock kam ho to poora transaction rollback hota hai (partial transfer kabhi nahi banta).

items.en: Branch's inventory only updates when receipt is confirmed, not at dispatch.
items.hi: Branch ki inventory sirf receipt confirm hone par update hoti hai, dispatch ke time nahi.

items.en: Optionally it can link to an internal requisition line (requisitionLineId) — then the system checks total dispatch never exceeds the approved qty.
items.hi: Optionally isko internal requisition line se link kiya ja sakta hai (requisitionLineId) — tab system check karta hai ki total dispatch approved qty se zyada na ho.

example.en: No separate worked example is given for dispatch alone — see the Confirm Receipt example which covers a full dispatch-and-receive cycle.
example.hi: Sirf dispatch ke liye alag example nahi diya gaya — Confirm Receipt ka example dekho jo poora dispatch-and-receive cycle cover karta hai.

items.summaryEn: A DISPATCHED transfer gets its actual received quantity confirmed by the branch — partial receive is possible, even per-lot.
items.summaryHi: DISPATCHED transfer ki actual received quantity branch confirm karta hai — partial receive possible hai, per-lot bhi.

items.en: In "Stock Transfers" tab, click "Receive" on a DISPATCHED transfer.
items.hi: "Stock Transfers" tab mein, DISPATCHED transfer par "Receive" click karo.

items.en: If the dispatch came from multiple lots (batches), each lot's received quantity can be entered separately — full dispatched is prefilled, change for shortfall.
items.hi: Agar dispatch multiple lots (batches) se hua hai, to har lot ki received quantity alag se enter ki ja sakti hai — full dispatched prefilled hota hai, shortfall ke liye change karo.

items.en: Click "Confirm Receipt" — the system shows variance (dispatched minus received).
items.hi: "Confirm Receipt" click karo — system variance dikhata hai (dispatched minus received).

items.en: Received quantity can never exceed dispatched quantity.
items.hi: Received quantity dispatched quantity se kabhi zyada nahi ho sakti.

items.en: If dispatch came from multiple lots and received total is less than dispatched total (real shortfall), a per-lot breakdown is mandatory — a single aggregate number is not allowed (ambiguous which lot came short).
items.hi: Agar dispatch multiple lots se hua aur received total dispatched total se kam ho (real shortfall), to per-lot breakdown mandatory hai — sirf ek aggregate number allow nahi hai (pata nahi chalta kaunsa lot kam aaya).

items.en: A single-lot dispatch, or full-qty multi-lot receive, makes the per-lot breakdown optional.
items.hi: Single-lot dispatch, ya full-qty multi-lot receive, par per-lot breakdown optional ho jaata hai.

items.en: The original dispatched lot's identity (batchNo, expiry) is preserved when the branch gets credited — a fabricated "unknown origin" batch is never created when the real lot is known.
items.hi: Branch ko credit karte waqt original dispatched lot ki identity (batchNo, expiry) preserve rehti hai — real lot pata ho to fabricated "unknown origin" batch kabhi nahi banta.

items.en: Receive is idempotent: the exact same repeated request doesn't double-credit, it just returns the stored result again.
items.hi: Receive idempotent hai: exact same repeated request double-credit nahi karta, sirf stored result dobara return karta hai.

items.en: A different request trying to receive an already-received transfer gets a 409 error.
items.hi: Already-received transfer ko dobara receive karne ki alag request par 409 error aata hai.

example.en: Central dispatched 10kg "Chawal" — 2 lots: Lot A 6kg (expiry 2026-12-01), Lot B 4kg (expiry 2026-12-15). Branch only received 9kg (1kg spilled/damaged in transit). Staff confirms Lot A 6kg, Lot B 3kg. Total received = 9kg, variance = 1kg (shortfall flagged). Branch stock gets credited with those same 2 original lots (6kg of expiry 12/01, 3kg of expiry 12/15) — no "unknown" lot created.
example.hi: Central ne 10kg "Chawal" dispatch kiya — 2 lots: Lot A 6kg (expiry 2026-12-01), Lot B 4kg (expiry 2026-12-15). Branch ko sirf 9kg mila (1kg transit mein spill/damage hua). Staff Lot A 6kg, Lot B 3kg confirm karta hai. Total received = 9kg, variance = 1kg (shortfall flag hota hai). Branch stock ko wahi 2 original lots credit hote hain (6kg of expiry 12/01, 3kg of expiry 12/15) — koi "unknown" lot nahi banta.

items.summaryHi: Branch raw materials ke liye internal demand raise karta hai — abhi vendor ya PO involve nahi hota.

items.hi: Branch select karo, 1-50 line items (material + quantity) enter karo.

items.en: Click "Raise" — the indent saves in DRAFT status.
items.hi: "Raise" click karo — indent DRAFT status mein save hota hai.

items.hi: DRAFT indent sirf ek draft hai, abhi approval queue mein nahi hai.

items.titleEn: Submit Indent for Approval (Spike + Value Gate)
items.titleHi: Submit Indent for Approval (Spike + Value Gate)
items.summaryEn: Submitting a DRAFT indent runs two independent checks — quantity spike and value threshold — before auto-approving or sending it to Owner.
items.summaryHi: DRAFT indent submit karne par do independent checks chalte hain — quantity spike aur value threshold — fir auto-approve hota hai ya Owner ko jaata hai.

items.en: Click "Submit for Approval" on a DRAFT row.
items.hi: DRAFT row par "Submit for Approval" click karo.

items.en: The system automatically decides APPROVED (free path) or PENDING_APPROVAL (needs Owner review).
items.hi: System automatically decide karta hai APPROVED (free path) ya PENDING_APPROVAL (Owner review zaroori).

items.en: Computes a rolling average of the last 30 days' actually-posted GRNs (status APPROVED, meaning real quality-passed receipts) per material.
items.hi: Har material ke liye last 30 din ke actually-posted GRNs (status APPROVED, yaani real quality-passed receipts) ka rolling average compute hota hai.

items.en: Needs at least 3 samples, or there's "no real baseline" — in that state the indent automatically goes PENDING_APPROVAL, never fabricating an average.
items.hi: Kam se kam 3 samples zaroori hain, warna "no real baseline" hota hai — tab indent automatically PENDING_APPROVAL ho jaata hai, average kabhi fabricate nahi hota.

items.en: If the requested qty is more than 25% above the average, a spike flag triggers -> PENDING_APPROVAL, and the exact spike% (e.g. +40.5%) is saved.
items.hi: Agar requested qty average se 25% zyada ho, to spike flag trigger hota hai -> PENDING_APPROVAL, aur exact spike% (jaise +40.5%) save hota hai.

items.en: If Owner set a TSh value threshold in Business Policy, the indent's estimated value (latest locked vendor rate x requested qty) is calculated.
items.hi: Agar Owner ne Business Policy mein TSh value threshold set kiya ho, indent ki estimated value (latest locked vendor rate x requested qty) calculate hoti hai.

items.en: If any material's locked rate is missing, the estimate is treated as "unknown" and fails closed — meaning PENDING_APPROVAL is forced, never silently auto-approved on unknown cost.
items.hi: Agar kisi material ka locked rate missing ho, estimate "unknown" treat hoti hai aur fail-closed hoti hai — matlab PENDING_APPROVAL force hota hai, unknown cost par silently auto-approve kabhi nahi hota.

items.en: If the estimated value is at or above the threshold, it goes PENDING_APPROVAL.
items.hi: Agar estimated value threshold ke equal ya zyada ho, to PENDING_APPROVAL ho jaata hai.

items.en: Whichever check triggers, it goes PENDING_APPROVAL — only when both checks are clear does it get auto-APPROVED.
items.hi: Jo bhi check trigger ho, PENDING_APPROVAL ho jaata hai — sirf jab dono checks clear hon tab auto-APPROVED hota hai.

example.en: "Paneer" 30-day average is 20kg/order (5 samples). The indent requests 30kg — 30 > 20x1.25=25, spike detected (+50% over average) -> PENDING_APPROVAL, regardless of whether the value threshold is enabled.
example.hi: "Paneer" ka 30-day average 20kg/order hai (5 samples). Indent 30kg request karta hai — 30 > 20x1.25=25, spike detect hota hai (+50% average se zyada) -> PENDING_APPROVAL, value threshold enabled ho ya na ho.

items.summaryEn: A PENDING_APPROVAL indent is reviewed only by the Owner — never the branch manager or requester.
items.summaryHi: PENDING_APPROVAL indent sirf Owner review karta hai — branch manager ya requester kabhi nahi.

items.en: "Approve" or "Reject" button is visible only to SUPER_ADMIN on PENDING_APPROVAL rows.
items.hi: "Approve" ya "Reject" button sirf SUPER_ADMIN ko PENDING_APPROVAL rows par dikhta hai.

items.en: Only Owner can approve/reject — never the branch manager or requester themselves (GAP-016 mandatory HO approval rule).
items.hi: Sirf Owner approve/reject kar sakta hai — branch manager ya requester khud kabhi nahi (GAP-016 mandatory HO approval rule).

items.en: An approved indent moves to "APPROVED" status, and a PO can now be raised against it.
items.hi: Approved indent "APPROVED" status mein chala jaata hai, aur ab usi par PO raise ho sakta hai.

items.en: Click "New Purchase", leave the "General purchase" checkbox unchecked.
items.hi: "New Purchase" click karo, "General purchase" checkbox unchecked rakho.

items.hi: Branch, Vendor select karo; "Full indent ID" enter karo aur "Look up approved indent" karo (latest 200 approved indents dropdown mein pehle se dikhte hain; purane ke liye full-ID lookup chahiye).

items.en: Selecting the approved indent shows all materials/quantities locked (must exactly match the indent) — enter a rate (TSh/unit) for each line.
items.hi: Approved indent select karne par sab materials/quantities locked dikhte hain (indent se exactly match hona chahiye) — har line ke liye rate (TSh/unit) enter karo.

items.en: Click "Create (Step 1: Buy)".
items.hi: "Create (Step 1: Buy)" click karo.

items.en: Check the "General purchase" checkbox.
items.hi: "General purchase" checkbox check karo.

items.en: Enter Branch, Vendor, Item description, Amount (TSh).
items.hi: Branch, Vendor, Item description, Amount (TSh) enter karo.

items.en: Click "Create (Step 1: Buy)".
items.hi: "Create (Step 1: Buy)" click karo.

items.en: Store purchase requires an APPROVED indent; General purchase is not allowed to have an indent.
items.hi: Store purchase ke liye APPROVED indent zaroori hai; General purchase ke saath indent allowed nahi hai.

items.en: The PO's materials and quantities must exactly match the approved indent, compared in aggregate including duplicate lines.
items.hi: PO ke materials aur quantities approved indent se exactly match hona chahiye, aggregate mein compare hota hai duplicate lines sahit.

items.en: The vendor must be in APPROVED status — a DRAFT or SUSPENDED vendor cannot have a PO created at all (server-side hard enforce, cannot be bypassed from UI).
items.hi: Vendor APPROVED status mein hona chahiye — DRAFT ya SUSPENDED vendor ke liye PO bilkul nahi ban sakta (server-side hard enforce, UI se bypass nahi ho sakta).

items.en: If a vendor is restricted to a specific branch/category, a PO outside that scope is rejected.
items.hi: Agar vendor kisi specific branch/category tak restricted hai, to scope ke bahar PO reject ho jaata hai.

items.en: General Purchase value gate (GAP-016): if Owner set a threshold and the general purchase value is at/above it, a separate "General Purchase HO Approvals" request must be APPROVED first (its generalPurchaseRequestId must be passed) — the general-purchase flag alone cannot skip this review.
items.hi: General Purchase value gate (GAP-016): agar Owner ne threshold set kiya hai aur general purchase value usse equal/zyada ho, to pehle alag "General Purchase HO Approvals" request APPROVED honi chahiye (uska generalPurchaseRequestId pass karna hoga) — general-purchase flag se yeh review skip nahi ho sakta.

items.en: PO creation sets status "CREATED" and the linked indent (if any) becomes "PO_RAISED".
items.hi: PO creation se status "CREATED" set hota hai aur linked indent (agar ho) "PO_RAISED" ho jaata hai.

example.en: Indent had "Aata" 50kg + "Namak" 5kg approved. While creating the PO, rate entered was Aata TSh45/kg, Namak TSh20/kg. PO Amount = 50x45 + 5x20 = TSh2350.
example.hi: Indent mein "Aata" 50kg + "Namak" 5kg approved tha. PO banate waqt rate Aata TSh45/kg, Namak TSh20/kg daala gaya. PO Amount = 50x45 + 5x20 = TSh2350.

items.summaryEn: Attaching the vendor's physical bill as an optional record — the actual 3-way-match invoice step is separate.
items.summaryHi: Vendor ka physical bill optional record ke roop mein attach karna — actual 3-way-match invoice step alag hai.

items.en: In the PO row, choose a file (PDF/PNG/JPEG/WEBP) under "Upload Bill (optional)" — it uploads automatically.
items.hi: PO row mein, "Upload Bill (optional)" ke under file (PDF/PNG/JPEG/WEBP) choose karo — automatically upload ho jaata hai.

items.en: Once a bill is uploaded, re-upload is not allowed (assertPoNotBilled).
items.hi: Bill ek baar upload ho gaya to re-upload allow nahi hai (assertPoNotBilled).

items.titleEn: Step 3 — Mark Material Received / Receive Remaining (Multi-Delivery GRN)
items.titleHi: Step 3 — Mark Material Received / Receive Remaining (Multi-Delivery GRN)
items.summaryEn: When vendor goods arrive, a GRN is created ready for Quality Check — a PO can split across multiple deliveries.
items.summaryHi: Vendor ka saaman aane par GRN banta hai jo Quality Check ke liye ready hota hai — ek PO multiple deliveries mein split ho sakta hai.

items.en: Click "Mark Material Received" (or "Receive Remaining" if already PARTIALLY_RECEIVED).
items.hi: "Mark Material Received" click karo (ya "Receive Remaining" agar already PARTIALLY_RECEIVED hai).

items.en: The system computes each PO line's outstanding quantity (ordered minus already-received in all prior GRNs), and creates a PENDING GRN.
items.hi: System har PO line ki outstanding quantity compute karta hai (ordered minus already-received sabhi prior GRNs mein), aur ek PENDING GRN banta hai.

items.en: The GRN now shows in the "GRN/Quality" tab for quality check.
items.hi: GRN ab "GRN/Quality" tab mein quality check ke liye dikhta hai.

items.en: Any PO line that is fully received is no longer available for another receive attempt.
items.hi: Jo PO line fully received ho gayi, usko dobara receive karne ki koshish nahi ho sakti.

items.en: If a line was received with a real shortage (e.g. 100kg ordered, 80kg arrived), the PO status becomes "PARTIALLY_RECEIVED"; once all lines are fully received, the status becomes "RECEIVED".
items.hi: Agar kisi line mein real shortage ho (jaise 100kg order, 80kg aaya), to PO status "PARTIALLY_RECEIVED" ho jaata hai; sab lines fully receive hone par status "RECEIVED" ho jaata hai.

items.en: A re-receive attempt on a fully-received PO gives a 409 error.
items.hi: Fully-received PO par dobara receive karne ki koshish 409 error deti hai.

items.en: This step only creates a GRN — stock is never posted here, stock only posts at Quality Check.
items.hi: Yeh step sirf GRN banata hai — stock yahan kabhi post nahi hota, stock sirf Quality Check par post hota hai.

example.en: PO had 100kg "Dal" ordered. First receive got only 70kg (vendor shortage) — GRN1 created with qtyReceived=70, PO status "PARTIALLY_RECEIVED". Days later the remaining 30kg arrives — "Receive Remaining" creates GRN2 with qtyReceived=30 (outstanding = 100-70=30), PO status "RECEIVED".
example.hi: PO mein 100kg "Dal" order kiya gaya. Pehli receive mein sirf 70kg mila (vendor shortage) — GRN1 bana qtyReceived=70, PO status "PARTIALLY_RECEIVED". Kuch din baad baaki 30kg aata hai — "Receive Remaining" se GRN2 banta hai qtyReceived=30 (outstanding = 100-70=30), PO status "RECEIVED".

items.summaryEn: Giving a PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL verdict on received material and posting the correct accepted quantity to inventory.
items.summaryHi: Received material par PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL verdict dena aur correct accepted quantity inventory mein post karna.

items.en: In the "GRN/Quality" tab, click "Quality Check" on a pending GRN.
items.hi: "GRN/Quality" tab mein, pending GRN par "Quality Check" click karo.

items.en: Choose a result: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL.
items.hi: Result choose karo: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL.

items.en: In PARTIAL, enter each line's "Failed quantity" (less than received, more than 0).
items.hi: PARTIAL mein har line ki "Failed quantity" enter karo (received se kam, 0 se zyada).

items.en: For a store purchase (raw material) and a result other than FAIL, enter batch reference and original expiry date (or non-expiring + evidence, Owner-only) for each accepted line.
items.hi: Store purchase (raw material) aur FAIL ke alawa result ke liye, har accepted line ke liye batch reference aur original expiry date enter karo (ya non-expiring + evidence, Owner-only).

items.en: Write a quality note — at least 3 characters required for FAIL/PARTIAL.
items.hi: Quality note likho — FAIL/PARTIAL ke liye kam se kam 3 characters zaroori hain.

items.en: Click "Save quality" to finalize.
items.hi: Finalize karne ke liye "Save quality" click karo.

items.en: PASS -> no line's failed qty can be greater than 0.
items.hi: PASS -> kisi bhi line ki failed qty 0 se zyada nahi ho sakti.

items.en: FAIL -> all lines are fully failed (accepted=0).
items.hi: FAIL -> saari lines fully failed hoti hain (accepted=0).

items.en: PARTIAL -> at least one line must be part-failed, and at least one line must be part-accepted (can't mark PARTIAL on a full-pass or full-fail).
items.hi: PARTIAL -> kam se kam ek line part-failed honi chahiye, aur kam se kam ek line part-accepted honi chahiye (full-pass ya full-fail par PARTIAL mark nahi kiya ja sakta).

items.en: Quality check requires the PURCHASE_ORDER module; for a store purchase, the INVENTORY module is also required (general purchase only needs PURCHASE_ORDER).
items.hi: Quality check ke liye PURCHASE_ORDER module zaroori hai; store purchase ke liye INVENTORY module bhi zaroori hai (general purchase ko sirf PURCHASE_ORDER chahiye).

items.en: The quality decision is atomic — accepted stock (qtyReceived minus qtyFailed) posts to inventory + stock-ledger + expiry batches in the same transaction, all-or-nothing.
items.hi: Quality decision atomic hai — accepted stock (qtyReceived minus qtyFailed) inventory + stock-ledger + expiry batches mein same transaction mein post hota hai, all-or-nothing.

items.en: General purchase saves the quality decision but never posts to inventory (it isn't stock at all).
items.hi: General purchase quality decision save karta hai lekin inventory mein kabhi post nahi karta (yeh stock bilkul nahi hai).

items.en: Once a quality decision is saved, it can never be edited — the exact same request repeated is a safe "replay" no-op, but a different decision on the same GRN is rejected ("already finalized with a different decision").
items.hi: Ek baar quality decision save hone ke baad edit nahi ho sakta — exact same request repeat karna safe "replay" no-op hai, lekin same GRN par alag decision reject ho jaata hai ("already finalized with a different decision").

items.en: FAIL/PARTIAL automatically queues a Vendor Return claim — this triggers itself, no manual action needed.
items.hi: FAIL/PARTIAL automatically Vendor Return claim queue karta hai — yeh khud trigger hota hai, manual action ki zaroorat nahi.

example.en: GRN had 50kg "Tamatar" received. Quality check found 5kg spoiled -> result "PARTIAL", failed qty = 5kg. Accepted = 45kg posted to inventory, batch created (batchNo and expiry entered). A 5kg vendor claim is auto-queued.
example.hi: GRN mein 50kg "Tamatar" received hua. Quality check mein 5kg spoiled nikla -> result "PARTIAL", failed qty = 5kg. Accepted = 45kg inventory mein post hota hai, batch banta hai (batchNo aur expiry enter kiya gaya). 5kg ka vendor claim auto-queue hota hai.

items.summaryEn: Whenever quality is FAIL/PARTIAL, an expected refund claim is automatically created — no cash has moved yet.
items.summaryHi: Jab bhi quality FAIL/PARTIAL ho, ek expected refund claim automatically banta hai — abhi tak koi cash move nahi hua.

items.en: Auto: a new FAIL/PARTIAL quality decision auto-queues the claim, nothing to do manually.
items.hi: Auto: naya FAIL/PARTIAL quality decision claim auto-queue karta hai, manually kuch nahi karna.

items.en: Manual register (for an old historical FAIL/PARTIAL GRN): in the "Vendor returns" tab, enter the full GRN ID and "Look up finalized GRN".
items.hi: Manual register (purane historical FAIL/PARTIAL GRN ke liye): "Vendor returns" tab mein full GRN ID enter karo aur "Look up finalized GRN" karo.

items.en: Select it from the dropdown, click "Register failed-quantity claim".
items.hi: Dropdown se select karo, "Register failed-quantity claim" click karo.

items.en: Refund amount = qtyFailed x rateOrdered (the PO's locked rate, not the invoice's rate), with exact paisa rounding.
items.hi: Refund amount = qtyFailed x rateOrdered (PO ka locked rate, invoice ka rate nahi), exact paisa rounding ke saath.

items.en: A claim can only be registered on a trusted finalized FAIL/PARTIAL GRN whose quality decision is already properly recorded and reconciled.
items.hi: Claim sirf ek trusted finalized FAIL/PARTIAL GRN par register ho sakta hai jiska quality decision pehle se properly recorded aur reconciled hai.

items.en: This claim is only "expected" — no cash, journal entry, or physical dispatch confirmation is posted here.
items.hi: Yeh claim sirf "expected" hai — yahan koi cash, journal entry ya physical dispatch confirmation post nahi hota.

example.en: GRN had 5kg Tamatar failed, rate was TSh30/kg. Claim amount = 5 x 30 = TSh150 (expected credit/refund).
example.hi: GRN mein 5kg Tamatar failed tha, rate TSh30/kg tha. Claim amount = 5 x 30 = TSh150 (expected credit/refund).

items.summaryEn: When the vendor actually sends money or a credit note, Accounts marks the claim as Settled, once only.
items.summaryHi: Jab vendor actually money ya credit note bhejta hai, Accounts claim ko ek baar Settled mark karta hai.

items.en: Accounts/Owner enters the settled amount and an optional note on the claim, then clicks "Mark as Settled".
items.hi: Accounts/Owner claim par settled amount aur optional note enter karta hai, phir "Mark as Settled" click karta hai.

items.en: Only the ACCOUNTS_EXPENSES module holder or Owner can do this.
items.hi: Sirf ACCOUNTS_EXPENSES module holder ya Owner yeh kar sakta hai.

items.en: It is once-only — a claim cannot be settled twice.
items.hi: Yeh once-only hai — claim do baar settle nahi ho sakta.

example.hi: Is section ke liye source mein koi worked example nahi diya gaya.

items.titleEn: Physical Return Dispatch (Sending Rejected Stock Back to Vendor)
items.titleHi: Physical Return Dispatch (Rejected Stock Vendor Ko Wapas Bhejna)
items.summaryEn: Physically sending the failed/rejected goods back to the vendor with evidence — this never touches stock.
items.summaryHi: Failed/rejected goods ko physically evidence ke saath vendor ko wapas bhejna — yeh stock ko kabhi touch nahi karta.

items.en: Enter qty, reason, evidence photo URL (optional) against the claim, click "Record dispatch" — partial dispatch is possible (multiple trips).
items.hi: Claim ke against qty, reason, evidence photo URL (optional) enter karo, "Record dispatch" click karo — partial dispatch possible hai (multiple trips).

items.en: When the vendor confirms/signs the receipt, click "Mark vendor-acknowledged".
items.hi: Jab vendor receipt confirm/sign kare, "Mark vendor-acknowledged" click karo.

items.en: If some quantity won't be dispatched at all (e.g. vendor destroyed it on the spot), Owner clicks "Cancel remaining".
items.hi: Agar kuch quantity bilkul dispatch nahi hogi (jaise vendor ne wahin destroy kar diya), Owner "Cancel remaining" click karta hai.

items.en: This never touches stock — the failed qty never entered usable inventory in the first place.
items.hi: Yeh stock ko kabhi touch nahi karta — failed qty pehle se usable inventory mein kabhi gayi hi nahi thi.

items.en: Total dispatched can never exceed the claim's qtyReturned (the sum of multiple partial dispatches is checked).
items.hi: Total dispatched claim ke qtyReturned se kabhi zyada nahi ho sakta (multiple partial dispatches ka sum check hota hai).

items.en: "Cancel remaining" is Owner-only, and only works when something is still pending (a fully-dispatched claim can't be cancelled).
items.hi: "Cancel remaining" sirf Owner ke liye hai, aur sirf tab kaam karta hai jab kuch pending ho (fully-dispatched claim cancel nahi ho sakta).

items.en: Vendor-acknowledge is once-only per dispatch.
items.hi: Vendor-acknowledge har dispatch ke liye ek baar hi ho sakta hai.

example.en: Claim is for 5kg. First trip dispatched 3kg, second trip 2kg — total 5kg, remaining = 0, "Cancel remaining" button becomes inactive.
example.hi: Claim 5kg ke liye hai. Pehli trip mein 3kg dispatch hua, dusri trip mein 2kg — total 5kg, remaining = 0, "Cancel remaining" button inactive ho jaata hai.

items.summaryEn: Issuing a formal numbered debit-note document against a vendor claim, exactly equal to the claim amount.
items.summaryHi: Vendor claim ke against formal numbered debit-note document issue karna, exactly claim amount ke equal.

items.en: "Issue debit note" (with a reason) — the number auto-generates (e.g. DN-000012).
items.hi: "Issue debit note" (reason ke saath) — number auto-generate hota hai (jaise DN-000012).

items.en: It can also be cancelled; the number is never reused.
items.hi: Yeh cancel bhi ho sakta hai; number kabhi reuse nahi hota.

items.en: Only ACCOUNTS_EXPENSES/Owner can issue or cancel a debit note.
items.hi: Sirf ACCOUNTS_EXPENSES/Owner debit note issue ya cancel kar sakte hain.

items.en: Only one active (non-cancelled) debit note per claim at a time — the old one must be cancelled before issuing a new one.
items.hi: Ek claim par ek time par sirf ek active (non-cancelled) debit note ho sakta hai — naya issue karne se pehle purana cancel karna hoga.

items.en: Amount always exactly equals the claim's refundAmountInr — it cannot be manually changed.
items.hi: Amount hamesha claim ke refundAmountInr ke exactly equal hota hai — manually change nahi ho sakta.

example.hi: Is section ke liye source mein koi worked example nahi diya gaya.

items.summaryEn: Recording the vendor's invoice and automatically comparing it to PO total, GRN accepted value, and the adjusted invoice amount.
items.summaryHi: Vendor ka invoice record karna aur automatically PO total, GRN accepted value, aur adjusted invoice amount se compare karna.

items.en: Once the PO is fully "RECEIVED" (every GRN quality-checked), click "4. Invoice & Payment".
items.hi: Jab PO fully "RECEIVED" ho jaaye (har GRN quality-checked ho), "4. Invoice & Payment" click karo.

items.en: Enter invoice number, amount; optional tax adjustment (+/-), and if entered a reason must also be written.
items.hi: Invoice number, amount enter karo; optional tax adjustment (+/-), agar diya ho to reason bhi likhna zaroori hai.

items.en: Attach the invoice document (optional upload), click "Record invoice" — the system auto-matches.
items.hi: Invoice document attach karo (optional upload), "Record invoice" click karo — system auto-match karta hai.

items.en: An invoice can only be recorded once per PO.
items.hi: Ek PO par invoice sirf ek baar record ho sakta hai.

items.en: All of the PO's GRNs must already have quality recorded (no PENDING GRN left), or it's treated as "incomplete accepted value".
items.hi: PO ke saare GRNs ka quality pehle se recorded hona chahiye (koi PENDING GRN na bache), warna "incomplete accepted value" treat hota hai.

items.en: 3-way match formula: GRN accepted value (sum of (qtyReceived-qtyFailed) x rateOrdered) vs Invoice (adjusted) (invoice.amount + taxAdjustmentInr).
items.hi: 3-way match formula: GRN accepted value (sum of (qtyReceived-qtyFailed) x rateOrdered) vs Invoice (adjusted) (invoice.amount + taxAdjustmentInr).

items.en: PO total is shown separately but is only informational — a genuine difference between PO total and GRN accepted value is normal when quality has failed some qty.
items.hi: PO total alag se dikhaya jaata hai lekin sirf informational hai — PO total aur GRN accepted value mein genuine difference normal hai jab quality mein kuch qty fail hui ho.

items.en: Tolerance is TSh1.00 — a bigger difference is a "Mismatch" and payment becomes THREE_WAY_LOCKED (cannot be approved/paid until reconciled).
items.hi: Tolerance TSh1.00 hai — usse zyada difference "Mismatch" hai aur payment THREE_WAY_LOCKED ho jaata hai (reconcile hone tak approve/paid nahi ho sakta).

items.en: On a match, payment status starts at "PENDING".
items.hi: Match hone par payment status "PENDING" se start hota hai.

example.en: PO total was TSh2350. GRN had 5kg fail (Tamatar @ TSh30), so GRN accepted value is lower than PO total — this is normal. Vendor invoice was TSh2200. If GRN accepted value is also TSh2200 (±TSh1), it shows "Matched".
example.hi: PO total TSh2350 tha. GRN mein 5kg fail hua (Tamatar @ TSh30), isliye GRN accepted value PO total se kam hai — yeh normal hai. Vendor invoice TSh2200 tha. Agar GRN accepted value bhi TSh2200 (±TSh1) ho, to "Matched" dikhata hai.

items.summaryEn: Accounts approves a matched invoice, then records actual payment evidence — exact amount only, once per match.
items.summaryHi: Accounts matched invoice approve karta hai, phir actual payment evidence record karta hai — exact amount, ek baar hi per match.

items.en: If the match is "Matched" and status "PENDING", click "Approve payment" (Accounts-only).
items.hi: Agar match "Matched" hai aur status "PENDING" hai, "Approve payment" click karo (Accounts-only).

items.en: Once status is "APPROVED", fill Payment Method (Bank Transfer/Cash/Cheque/Mobile Money), Reference number, Paid date; click "Mark paid".
items.hi: Status "APPROVED" hone par, Payment Method (Bank Transfer/Cash/Cheque/Mobile Money), Reference number, Paid date fill karo; "Mark paid" click karo.

items.en: A mismatched (unmatched/THREE_WAY_LOCKED) invoice can never have payment approved.
items.hi: Mismatched (unmatched/THREE_WAY_LOCKED) invoice ka payment kabhi approve nahi ho sakta.

items.en: Payment can only be for the full outstanding amount exactly (invoiceAdjustedTotalInr) — partial payment is not yet approved, exact amount match is required.
items.hi: Payment sirf full outstanding amount ke liye exactly hota hai (invoiceAdjustedTotalInr) — partial payment approve nahi hota, exact amount match zaroori hai.

items.en: Only one payment record is ever possible per match — re-allocation is rejected.
items.hi: Ek match par sirf ek hi payment record possible hai — re-allocation reject ho jaata hai.

items.en: An idempotency key is used — same key + same payload is a safe replay retry; same key + different payload is rejected.
items.hi: Idempotency key use hoti hai — same key + same payload safe replay retry hai; same key + different payload reject ho jaata hai.

example.hi: Is section ke liye source mein koi worked example nahi diya gaya.

items.summaryEn: A corrupt/inconsistent GRN quality state halts everything and must be Owner-reconciled — the system never silently fixes itself.
items.summaryHi: Corrupt/inconsistent GRN quality state sab kuch rok deta hai aur Owner ko manually reconcile karna hota hai — system kabhi silently fix nahi karta.

items.en: If a GRN's saved quality state is found corrupt/inconsistent (legacy data, or an audit trail mismatch), the system shows "Reconciliation required" and blocks any further quality action.
items.hi: Agar GRN ka saved quality state corrupt/inconsistent paya jaaye (legacy data, ya audit trail mismatch), system "Reconciliation required" dikhata hai aur aage koi quality action block kar deta hai.

items.en: It never re-posts stock until the Owner manually reconciles it.
items.hi: Owner manually reconcile kiye bina stock kabhi dobara post nahi hota.

items.en: The whole system follows a "never repost/never silently fix" principle — any uncertain state halts before auto-rewriting.
items.hi: Poora system "never repost/never silently fix" principle follow karta hai — koi bhi uncertain state auto-rewrite se pehle halt ho jaata hai.

items.summaryEn: New vendors start in DRAFT status and cannot be purchased from until the Owner approves them, optionally scoped.
items.summaryHi: Naye vendors DRAFT status mein start hote hain aur Owner approve kiye bina unse purchase nahi ho sakta, scope optional hai.

items.en: New vendors start in 'DRAFT' status and cannot be purchased from until Owner approves.
items.hi: Naye vendors 'DRAFT' status mein start hote hain aur Owner approve kiye bina unse purchase nahi ho sakta.

items.en: In the "Vendors" tab, enter scope (branch optional, category optional, reason optional) against each vendor.
items.hi: "Vendors" tab mein, har vendor ke against scope enter karo (branch optional, category optional, reason optional).

items.en: Click "Approve" or "Suspend" (both Owner-only).
items.hi: "Approve" ya "Suspend" click karo (dono Owner-only hain).

items.en: A DRAFT or SUSPENDED vendor can never have a new PO created — server-side enforced in the same transaction that creates the PO, cannot be bypassed from UI.
items.hi: DRAFT ya SUSPENDED vendor ke liye naya PO kabhi nahi ban sakta — server-side enforced same transaction mein jo PO banata hai, UI se bypass nahi ho sakta.

items.en: If branch-restricted, a PO can only be raised for that branch.
items.hi: Agar branch-restricted hai, to PO sirf wahi branch ke liye raise ho sakta hai.

items.en: If category-restricted, a PO can only be raised for that category's raw materials.
items.hi: Agar category-restricted hai, to PO sirf us category ke raw materials ke liye raise ho sakta hai.

items.en: Existing (old) vendors were already APPROVED in a one-time cutover (so purchasing wasn't suddenly interrupted) — only newly created vendors now start as DRAFT.
items.hi: Existing (purane) vendors ek baar ke cutover mein already APPROVED kar diye gaye the (taaki purchasing suddenly ruk na jaaye) — ab sirf newly created vendors DRAFT se start hote hain.

items.titleEn: HO Approvals — General Purchase Value Gate
items.titleHi: HO Approvals — General Purchase Value Gate
items.summaryEn: A general purchase above the Owner-set threshold needs a separate HO approval request before a PO can be created.
items.summaryHi: Owner-set threshold se zyada general purchase ke liye PO banane se pehle alag HO approval request zaroori hai.

items.en: A general purchase (skipping the indent) must also go through mandatory HO review if it's at/above an Owner-set value threshold — the 'general purchase' flag alone cannot skip this review.
items.hi: General purchase (indent skip karne wala) ko bhi mandatory HO review se guzarna padta hai agar woh Owner-set value threshold ke equal/zyada ho — sirf 'general purchase' flag se yeh review skip nahi hoti.

items.en: In the "HO Approvals" tab, enter branch, vendor, line items (description, qty, rate), click "Submit for review".
items.hi: "HO Approvals" tab mein, branch, vendor, line items (description, qty, rate) enter karo, "Submit for review" click karo.

items.en: If below threshold, it's instantly APPROVED — use that request id on the Purchase Orders tab.
items.hi: Threshold se neeche ho to instantly APPROVED ho jaata hai — Purchase Orders tab par usi request id ka use karo.

items.en: If at/above threshold, it goes 'PENDING_APPROVAL' — Owner will Approve/Reject.
items.hi: Threshold ke equal/zyada ho to 'PENDING_APPROVAL' ho jaata hai — Owner Approve/Reject karega.

items.en: An approved request's id must be passed when creating the Purchase Order.
items.hi: Purchase Order banate waqt approved request ka id pass karna zaroori hai.

items.en: Value calculation is exact: sum(qty x rate), with round-half-up only on the final total, not per-line rounding.
items.hi: Value calculation exact hai: sum(qty x rate), round-half-up sirf final total par hota hai, per-line rounding nahi.

items.en: An approved request can only be consumed once (status APPROVED -> CONSUMED when a PO is actually created) — the same approval cannot create two separate purchases.
items.hi: Approved request sirf ek baar consume ho sakta hai (status APPROVED -> CONSUMED jab PO actually banta hai) — same approval se do alag purchases nahi ban sakte.

items.en: If the PO's lines/value don't match the approved request (someone edited in between), a 'no longer matches' error occurs — a new request must be submitted.
items.hi: Agar PO ki lines/value approved request se match na ho (beech mein kisi ne edit kiya), 'no longer matches' error aata hai — naya request submit karna hoga.

example.en: Owner set threshold TSh50,000. 'AC repair' general purchase value is TSh60,000 -> PENDING_APPROVAL. Owner approves. Now creating the PO must pass this same request's id, or PO creation fails.
example.hi: Owner ne threshold TSh50,000 set kiya. 'AC repair' general purchase value TSh60,000 hai -> PENDING_APPROVAL. Owner approve karta hai. Ab PO banate waqt isi request ki id pass karni hogi, warna PO creation fail ho jaata hai.

items.summaryEn: Six system-wide principles — FEFO, HELD/expired hard-blocks, exact math, idempotency, self-approval block, and Owner-only gates.
items.summaryHi: Chhe system-wide principles — FEFO, HELD/expired hard-blocks, exact math, idempotency, self-approval block, aur Owner-only gates.

items.en: FEFO everywhere — wherever raw material consumption/dispatch happens (production, transfer, wastage), it always draws expiry-wise (earliest expiring first), whether branch stock or central warehouse.
items.hi: FEFO sab jagah — jahan bhi raw material consumption/dispatch ho (production, transfer, wastage), hamesha expiry-wise liya jaata hai (sabse pehle expire hone wala pehle), branch stock ho ya central warehouse.

items.en: HELD/Expired hard-block — an unknown-expiry or expired lot is never used in normal consumption/dispatch, unless explicitly an 'allowExpired' flow (like wastage or a stock-count shortfall where a real loss is already being recorded).
items.hi: HELD/Expired hard-block — unknown-expiry ya expired lot normal consumption/dispatch mein kabhi use nahi hota, jab tak koi explicit 'allowExpired' flow na ho (jaise wastage ya stock-count shortfall jahan real loss already record ho rahi hai).

items.en: Exact decimal math — every quantity/money calculation uses bigint/fixed-point, never JavaScript floating point, so money or 3-decimal quantities never drift.
items.hi: Exact decimal math — har quantity/money calculation bigint/fixed-point use karti hai, kabhi JavaScript floating point nahi, isliye money ya 3-decimal quantities kabhi drift nahi hoti.

items.en: Idempotency — every critical write (receive, quality, payment, conversion) has a replay-safe mechanism; the exact same retry is safe, a different payload is rejected.
items.hi: Idempotency — har critical write (receive, quality, payment, conversion) ka replay-safe mechanism hai; exact same retry safe hai, different payload reject ho jaata hai.

items.en: Self-approval block — wherever review/approval exists (stock count, indent), whoever submitted can never approve it themselves.
items.hi: Self-approval block — jahan bhi review/approval hoti hai (stock count, indent), jisne submit kiya woh khud kabhi approve nahi kar sakta.

items.en: Owner-only mandatory gates — indent spike/value threshold, general purchase value threshold, vendor approval, and requisition approval are all Owner-level decisions; branch staff can never bypass them.
items.hi: Owner-only mandatory gates — indent spike/value threshold, general purchase value threshold, vendor approval, aur requisition approval sab Owner-level decisions hain; branch staff kabhi bypass nahi kar sakta.

example.en: No single worked example applies here — these six rules are enforced consistently across every example already given in the Inventory, Warehouse, and Purchase modules above.
example.hi: Yahan ek single worked example apply nahi hota — yeh chhe rules upar diye gaye Inventory, Warehouse, aur Purchase modules ke har example mein consistently enforce hote hain.

items.summaryEn: Create and maintain the core employee record — separate from app login — with locked rules once leave history exists.
items.summaryHi: Employee ka core record banao aur maintain karo — login se alag hota hai — aur leave history aane ke baad kuch cheezen lock ho jaati hain.

items.en: An employee record is a "master record" — name, employment type, current rate, joining date, and an optional link to an app login.
items.hi: Employee record ek "master record" hota hai — naam, employment type, current rate, joining date, aur optional app-login link.

items.en: The employee record is separate from login — an employee can exist with no login at all.
items.hi: Employee record login se bilkul alag hota hai — employee bina kisi login ke bhi exist kar sakta hai.

items.en: Without a linked login, that employee cannot self-apply leave; only a manager (with PAYROLL or LEAVE_APPROVAL) can apply leave on their behalf.
items.hi: Agar login link nahi hai to wo employee khud leave apply nahi kar sakta; sirf manager (PAYROLL ya LEAVE_APPROVAL permission wala) uske liye leave apply kar sakta hai.

items.en: Fill "Employee name" (this requires PAYROLL permission).
items.hi: "Employee name" fill karo (iske liye PAYROLL permission chahiye).

items.en: "Linked user (optional)" dropdown picks an existing branch login not already linked to another employee, or choose "No login link".
items.hi: "Linked user (optional)" dropdown se ek existing branch login choose karo jo kisi aur employee se already linked na ho, ya "No login link" choose karo.

items.en: Choose "Employment type": ON_ROLL (monthly salary) or OFF_ROLL (daily wage).
items.hi: "Employment type" choose karo: ON_ROLL (monthly salary) ya OFF_ROLL (daily wage).

items.en: Rate field label changes based on type — "Monthly salary" for ON_ROLL, "Daily wage" for OFF_ROLL — must be a positive decimal with max 2 decimals; zero or negative is not allowed.
items.hi: Rate field ka label type ke hisaab se change hota hai — ON_ROLL ke liye "Monthly salary", OFF_ROLL ke liye "Daily wage" — positive decimal hona chahiye, max 2 decimal, zero ya negative allowed nahi.

items.en: Pick "Joined on" date — the first valid employment date, inclusive.
items.hi: "Joined on" date pick karo — employment ki pehli valid date, inclusive.

items.en: Click "Create employee" to save.
items.hi: Save karne ke liye "Create employee" click karo.

items.en: Server checks that from the join date onward there is no already-finalized payroll month for that branch (openInterval check).
items.hi: Server check karta hai ki join date se aage us branch ka koi already-finalized payroll month na ho (openInterval check).

items.en: You cannot create a new employee whose join date would affect an already-closed payroll month.
items.hi: Aap naya employee create nahi kar sakte agar uski join date kisi already-closed payroll month ko affect karegi.

items.en: Click "Edit / future rate" on an employee row.
items.hi: Employee row par "Edit / future rate" click karo.

items.en: You can change the name, or set "Left on" (exit date, inclusive; blank means still active).
items.hi: Naam change kar sakte ho, ya "Left on" (exit date, inclusive; blank matlab abhi bhi active) set kar sakte ho.

items.en: You can also change "Linked user" — but with a big restriction (see login-link lock rule below).
items.hi: "Linked user" bhi change kar sakte ho — par ek badi restriction ke saath (neeche login-link lock rule dekho).

items.en: Click "Save details" to save changes.
items.hi: Changes save karne ke liye "Save details" click karo.

items.en: If an employee EVER has any leave history record — PENDING, APPROVED, or REJECTED, any status — their userId login link gets locked permanently.
items.hi: Agar employee ke paas EVER koi bhi leave history record hai — PENDING, APPROVED, ya REJECTED, koi bhi status — uska userId login link permanently lock ho jaata hai.

items.en: Once locked, nobody — not even the Owner — can assign, replace, or clear that login link.
items.hi: Ek baar lock hone ke baad, koi bhi — Owner bhi nahi — us login link ko assign, replace, ya clear nahi kar sakta.

items.en: Other safe edits like name and exit date still work fine; only the login-link change is blocked.
items.hi: Doosre safe edits jaise naam aur exit date abhi bhi kaam karte hain; sirf login-link change block hota hai.

items.en: Reason: the system keeps no separate "snapshot" of the leave beneficiary — the original login on old leave history must stay the same for the audit trail.
items.hi: Reason: system leave ke beneficiary ka alag "snapshot" nahi rakhta — purani leave history ka original login audit trail ke liye same hi rehna chahiye.

items.en: Any attendance or non-rejected leave that falls after the chosen exit date blocks setting that exit date — error "Exit would invalidate attendance or leave".
items.hi: Agar chosen exit date ke baad koi attendance ya non-rejected leave hai, to exit date set nahi hone diya jaata — error "Exit would invalidate attendance or leave".

items.en: Future-dated attendance/leave entries must be cleared first, then the exit date can be set.
items.hi: Future-dated attendance/leave entries pehle clear karne honge, uske baad exit date set ho sakti hai.

example.en: An employee can exist with no login — only a manager with PAYROLL/LEAVE_APPROVAL can apply leave for them. Once that employee has any leave record (even rejected), their login link is locked forever, even for the Owner.
example.hi: Employee bina login ke exist kar sakta hai — sirf PAYROLL/LEAVE_APPROVAL wala manager unke liye leave apply kar sakta hai. Ek baar us employee ka koi leave record ban jaaye (rejected bhi), to uska login link forever lock ho jaata hai, Owner ke liye bhi.

items.summaryEn: Salary or wage is never directly overwritten — every change creates a new dated compensation row so past payroll stays untouched.
items.summaryHi: Salary ya wage kabhi directly overwrite nahi hoti — har change ek nayi dated compensation row banata hai, taaki past payroll untouched rahe.

sections.headingEn: Why Rates Are Scheduled, Not Overwritten
sections.headingHi: Rate Ko Overwrite Kyun Nahi Kiya Jaata

items.en: An employee's rate (salary/wage) is never directly overwritten — every rate change creates a NEW "compensation history" row effective from a future date.
items.hi: Employee ki rate (salary/wage) kabhi directly overwrite nahi hoti — har rate change ek NAYI "compensation history" row banata hai jo future date se effective hoti hai.

items.en: This way, a past finalized payroll never retroactively changes.
items.hi: Isse past finalized payroll kabhi retroactively change nahi hota.

items.en: In the employee editor, fill "New rate" and "Effective month (future)".
items.hi: Employee editor mein "New rate" aur "Effective month (future)" fill karo.

items.en: Click "Schedule rate" — this button only enables when the chosen month's -01 date is strictly future from today (business date).
items.hi: "Schedule rate" click karo — yeh button sirf tab enable hota hai jab chosen month ki -01 date business date se strictly future ho.

items.en: Condition 1: the new effective date must be strictly future from today's business date.
items.hi: Condition 1: naya effective date aaj ki business date se strictly future hona chahiye.

items.en: Condition 2: it must be the first day of a month — must end in -01; mid-month rate changes are not allowed.
items.hi: Condition 2: wo month ka first day hona chahiye — -01 mein end hona chahiye; mid-month rate change allowed nahi.

items.en: Condition 3: it must be strictly after the previous compensation row's effective date — cannot schedule a rate on or before the previous one.
items.hi: Condition 3: wo previous compensation row ki effective date se strictly baad hona chahiye — rate ko previous date par ya usse pehle schedule nahi kar sakte.

items.en: After passing those, the server also checks that no attendance or non-rejected leave already exists on/after the new effective date — if it does, reject "Rate change touches attendance or leave".
items.hi: Yeh pass hone ke baad, server yeh bhi check karta hai ki naye effective date se aage koi attendance ya non-rejected leave na ho — agar hai to "Rate change touches attendance or leave" reject ho jaata hai.

items.en: It also rejects the change if any finalized payroll month falls in that interval.
items.hi: Agar us interval mein koi finalized payroll month aata hai, to bhi change reject ho jaata hai.

example.en: Employee's current rate is TSh 500,000/month, effective 2026-01-01. Today is November 2026. Owner schedules TSh 550,000, effective 2027-01. This passes because 2027-01-01 is future, is a month-boundary, and is after 2026-01-01. If any attendance/leave already existed on/after 2027-01 (normally impossible since future dates are blocked), it would reject.
example.hi: Employee ki current rate TSh 500,000/month hai, effective 2026-01-01. Aaj November 2026 hai. Owner TSh 550,000 schedule karta hai, effective 2027-01. Yeh pass hota hai kyunki 2027-01-01 future hai, month-boundary hai, aur 2026-01-01 ke baad hai. Agar 2027-01 par/baad koi attendance/leave already exist karta (normally impossible, kyunki future dates block hain), to yeh reject ho jaata.

items.summaryEn: Every day each employee is marked PRESENT/HALF_DAY/ABSENT — this is the base data payroll calculates from.
items.summaryHi: Har din har employee ko PRESENT/HALF_DAY/ABSENT mark kiya jaata hai — yeh payroll calculation ka base data hai.

items.en: Choose "Attendance date" — today or past only, future date not allowed (max = today).
items.hi: "Attendance date" choose karo — sirf today ya past, future date allowed nahi (max = today).

items.en: For each employee row, choose a status from the dropdown and click "Save" — one employee at a time.
items.hi: Har employee row ke liye dropdown se status choose karo aur "Save" click karo — ek baar mein ek employee.

items.en: Future attendance (date > business date) is blocked outright.
items.hi: Future attendance (date > business date) seedha block hota hai.

items.en: If that employee already has an APPROVED leave on that date, attendance cannot be marked — error "Approved leave conflicts with attendance".
items.hi: Agar employee ki us date par already APPROVED leave hai, to attendance mark nahi ho sakta — error "Approved leave conflicts with attendance".

items.en: The UI shows such a row as read-only with an "Approved leave - read-only" label, and no mark-form appears.
items.hi: UI aisi row ko read-only dikhati hai "Approved leave - read-only" label ke saath, aur koi mark-form nahi aata.

items.en: Attendance cannot be marked or edited on a date inside a finalized payroll month (openInterval check) — error "Payroll month is finalized".
items.hi: Attendance ko finalized payroll month ke andar wali date par mark ya edit nahi kiya ja sakta (openInterval check) — error "Payroll month is finalized".

items.en: Marking the same employee+date again is an update (upsert), not a new row — it overwrites the previous status, as long as that date's payroll isn't finalized yet.
items.hi: Same employee+date ko dobara mark karna ek update (upsert) hai, nayi row nahi — pehla status overwrite ho jaata hai, jab tak us date ka payroll finalized nahi hua.

items.en: A missing date (no status given at all) is NEVER automatically assumed present or absent — it stays "missing" until explicitly marked.
items.hi: Missing date (koi status hi nahi diya gaya) kabhi automatically present ya absent nahi maana jaata — explicitly mark hone tak "missing" rehta hai.

example.en: On 5 November 2026, a branch has 3 employees. Ravi already has an approved paid leave for 5 Nov — his row shows "Approved leave - read-only - Paid", no mark-form appears. Suresh is marked PRESENT. Amit is still unmarked — payroll preview will show his 5 Nov date as "missing" until a status is given.
example.hi: 5 November 2026 ko, ek branch mein 3 employees hain. Ravi ki 5 Nov ko already approved paid leave hai — uski row mein "Approved leave - read-only - Paid" dikhta hai, koi mark-form nahi aata. Suresh PRESENT mark hota hai. Amit abhi tak unmarked hai — status diye jaane tak payroll preview mein uski 5 Nov date "missing" dikhegi.

items.summaryEn: An employee (or their manager) submits a leave request, and a different authorized reviewer approves or rejects it, deciding paid or unpaid.
items.summaryHi: Employee (ya unka manager) leave request submit karta hai, aur ek alag authorized reviewer use approve ya reject karta hai, paid ya unpaid decide karte hue.

items.en: "Employee" dropdown shows all branch employees if the actor has LEAVE_APPROVAL or PAYROLL (canSubmitOthers); otherwise only the employee linked to their own login shows.
items.hi: Agar actor ke paas LEAVE_APPROVAL ya PAYROLL hai (canSubmitOthers), to "Employee" dropdown mein saare branch employees dikhte hain; warna sirf unke apne login se linked employee dikhta hai.

items.en: Choose "Start date" and "End date" (inclusive).
items.hi: "Start date" aur "End date" (inclusive) choose karo.

items.en: Write "Reason" — required, max 1000 characters.
items.hi: "Reason" likho — required hai, max 1000 characters.

items.en: Click "Submit leave request" — this saves it as PENDING.
items.hi: "Submit leave request" click karo — yeh PENDING status mein save hota hai.

items.en: The date range must be within the employee's joining-to-exit window.
items.hi: Date range employee ki joining-to-exit window ke andar hona chahiye.

items.en: If any overlapping leave (not REJECTED) already exists in that range, it is blocked — error "Overlapping leave".
items.hi: Agar us range mein koi overlapping leave (REJECTED nahi) already exist karti hai, to block ho jaata hai — error "Overlapping leave".

items.en: If any attendance is already marked in that range, it is blocked — error "Attendance already marked" (attendance must be unmarked first, then leave applied).
items.hi: Agar us range mein attendance already marked hai, to block ho jaata hai — error "Attendance already marked" (pehle attendance unmark karo, phir leave apply karo).

items.en: Without manage-permission, an employee can only pick their own linked employee — cannot apply leave for someone else.
items.hi: Manage-permission ke bina, employee sirf apna hi linked employee pick kar sakta hai — kisi aur ke liye leave apply nahi kar sakta.

items.en: Click "Review request" on a PENDING request.
items.hi: PENDING request par "Review request" click karo.

items.en: Choose "Decision": Approve or Reject.
items.hi: "Decision" choose karo: Approve ya Reject.

items.en: If Approved, must explicitly choose "Leave pay treatment": Paid (only if allowed) or Unpaid — there is no default, it must be explicitly chosen.
items.hi: Agar Approved hai, to explicitly "Leave pay treatment" choose karna hi hoga: Paid (sirf agar allowed ho) ya Unpaid — koi default nahi hai, explicitly choose karna padega.

items.en: Optional "Review note" can be added.
items.hi: Optional "Review note" add kar sakte ho.

items.en: Click "Confirm decision" to finalize.
items.hi: Finalize karne ke liye "Confirm decision" click karo.

items.en: The review is rejected with 403 "Cannot review own leave request" if the reviewer is the same employee whose leave this is (employeeUserId === actor.id).
items.hi: Review 403 "Cannot review own leave request" ke saath reject hota hai agar reviewer wahi employee hai jiski leave hai (employeeUserId === actor.id).

items.en: It is also rejected if the reviewer is the same person who originally submitted the request (requestedById === actor.id).
items.hi: Yeh bhi reject hota hai agar reviewer wahi person hai jisne originally request submit ki thi (requestedById === actor.id).

items.en: This applies to the Owner too — if the Owner applied for their own leave (or is themselves the linked employee), the Owner cannot approve/reject their own request; some other authorized reviewer must do it.
items.hi: Yeh Owner par bhi apply hota hai — agar Owner ne apni hi leave apply ki (ya khud hi linked employee hain), to Owner apni hi request approve/reject nahi kar sakte; kisi aur authorized reviewer ko karna padega.

items.en: The UI shows "Cannot review own leave" and the "Review request" button doesn't even appear in these cases.
items.hi: In cases mein UI "Cannot review own leave" dikhati hai aur "Review request" button hi nahi aata.

items.en: The "Paid" option only shows/is allowed when the employee was ON_ROLL for the ENTIRE start-to-end date range of the leave (no OFF_ROLL rate-segment overlapping anywhere in between).
items.hi: "Paid" option sirf tab dikhta hai/allowed hota hai jab employee leave ki ENTIRE start-to-end date range ke liye ON_ROLL tha (beech mein koi OFF_ROLL rate-segment overlap na ho).

items.en: If any overlapping compensation segment is OFF_ROLL, the Paid option is removed — OFF_ROLL leave can only ever be Unpaid; the server also re-enforces this with "Off-roll leave must be unpaid".
items.hi: Agar koi overlapping compensation segment OFF_ROLL hai, to Paid option hata diya jaata hai — OFF_ROLL leave hamesha sirf Unpaid ho sakti hai; server bhi isko "Off-roll leave must be unpaid" se enforce karta hai.

items.en: Before approving, the system also checks that no attendance is already marked in that date range — error "Attendance conflicts with approval" — otherwise it would conflict in payroll calculation.
items.hi: Approve karne se pehle, system yeh bhi check karta hai ki us date range mein koi attendance already marked na ho — error "Attendance conflicts with approval" — warna payroll calculation mein conflict hoga.

example.en: Priya (ON_ROLL cook) applies for 3 days leave 10-12 Nov 2026 through her manager Raj (who has LEAVE_APPROVAL) — Raj submits it for her. At review time, Raj CANNOT review it himself (because requestedById === Raj.id); some other LEAVE_APPROVAL holder (like Owner) must review. Owner selects "Approved" + "Paid" (because Priya was fully ON_ROLL for all of 10-12 Nov) — now these 3 days become paid-leave-days in payroll.
example.hi: Priya (ON_ROLL cook) apne manager Raj (jiske paas LEAVE_APPROVAL hai) ke through 10-12 Nov 2026 ke 3 din ki leave apply karti hai — Raj uske liye submit karta hai. Review time par, Raj khud review NAHI kar sakta (kyunki requestedById === Raj.id); koi aur LEAVE_APPROVAL wala (jaise Owner) review karega. Owner "Approved" + "Paid" select karta hai (kyunki Priya 10-12 Nov ke poore time fully ON_ROLL thi) — ab yeh 3 din payroll mein paid-leave-days ban jaate hain.

items.summaryEn: Each month's salary/wage is calculated first as an editable DRAFT, then locked forever once FINALized.
items.summaryHi: Har mahine ki salary/wage pehle editable DRAFT ke roop mein calculate hoti hai, phir FINAL hone par forever lock ho jaati hai.

items.en: Each day earns "half-units": PRESENT = 2 units (1 full day), HALF_DAY = 1 unit (0.5 day), paid-leave-on-ON_ROLL = 2 units, ABSENT/unpaid-leave = 0 units.
items.hi: Har din "half-units" earn karta hai: PRESENT = 2 units (1 full day), HALF_DAY = 1 unit (0.5 day), paid-leave-on-ON_ROLL = 2 units, ABSENT/unpaid-leave = 0 units.

items.en: A day before the employee's joining, after exit, or a future date is simply skipped — not counted at all.
items.hi: Employee ki joining se pehle, exit ke baad, ya future date wala din simply skip ho jaata hai — count hi nahi hota.

items.en: ON_ROLL formula: amount = monthly_rate x (total_units / 2) / calendarDaysInMonth — i.e. "monthly salary / month's actual calendar days x payable days".
items.hi: ON_ROLL formula: amount = monthly_rate x (total_units / 2) / calendarDaysInMonth — matlab "monthly salary / month ke actual calendar days x payable days".

items.en: OFF_ROLL formula: amount = daily_wage x (total_units / 2) — i.e. "daily wage x worked units" (calendar-days factor cancels out of this formula).
items.hi: OFF_ROLL formula: amount = daily_wage x (total_units / 2) — matlab "daily wage x worked units" (calendar-days factor is formula mein cancel ho jaata hai).

items.en: If a rate change (compensation history) happened mid-month, each segment calculates at its own effective rate and sums into the total — a rateSegments array shows the breakdown.
items.hi: Agar mid-month rate change (compensation history) hua ho, to har segment apne hi effective rate par calculate hota hai aur total mein sum hota hai — rateSegments array breakdown dikhata hai.

items.en: Rounding happens at paisa-level precision (bigint paise), with a final round-half-up to 2 decimals.
items.hi: Rounding paisa-level precision (bigint paise) par hoti hai, aur final round-half-up 2 decimals tak hota hai.

items.en: If any employee-date combo was never marked at all (no attendance, no approved leave), it appears in that row's missingDates list.
items.hi: Agar koi employee-date combo bilkul mark nahi hua (no attendance, no approved leave), to wo us row ki missingDates list mein aata hai.

items.en: The Finalize button stays disabled until every employee's every date is complete — missing list empty for all.
items.hi: Finalize button disabled rehta hai jab tak har employee ki har date complete na ho — sabke liye missing list empty ho.

sections.headingEn: Finalize Conditions (canFinalize) — ALL Must Be True
sections.headingHi: Finalize Conditions (canFinalize) — Saare True Hone Chahiye

items.en: 1. Data has loaded — no error, not loading.
items.hi: 1. Data load ho gaya ho — no error, not loading.

items.en: 2. At least one employee row exists.
items.hi: 2. Kam se kam ek employee row exist karti ho.

items.en: 3. Every row's missingDates is empty — all dates complete.
items.hi: 3. Har row ki missingDates empty ho — saari dates complete.

items.en: 4. The month is past — the current or future month can never be finalized (compared against the business date).
items.hi: 4. Month past ho — current ya future month kabhi finalize nahi ho sakta (business date ke against compare hota hai).

items.en: 5. Not already finalized — cannot finalize twice.
items.hi: 5. Already finalized na ho — do baar finalize nahi kar sakte.

items.en: Even after the button becomes enabled, the UI has a confirmation checkbox ("I checked this branch, month and all amounts...") that must be manually ticked.
items.hi: Button enable hone ke baad bhi, UI mein ek confirmation checkbox hai ("I checked this branch, month and all amounts...") jo manually tick karni padti hai.

items.en: Once FINAL, a permanent snapshot saves in the payrollRuns and payrollSnapshots tables (status: "FINAL").
items.hi: Ek baar FINAL hone par, permanent snapshot payrollRuns aur payrollSnapshots tables mein save hota hai (status: "FINAL").

items.en: Calling payroll again for the same branch+month just returns the already-saved snapshot — it never recalculates.
items.hi: Same branch+month ke liye payroll dobara call karne par wo already-saved snapshot hi return hota hai — kabhi recalculate nahi hota.

items.en: Any attendance, leave, or employee rate change touching that closed period is rejected server-side (openInterval check everywhere).
items.hi: Us closed period ko touch karne wala koi bhi attendance, leave, ya employee rate change server-side reject ho jaata hai (openInterval check hamesha).

items.en: No bank transfer or actual payment happens — this is purely an accounting record/expense snapshot; the UI explicitly states "No money was transferred."
items.hi: Koi bank transfer ya actual payment nahi hoti — yeh sirf ek accounting record/expense snapshot hai; UI explicitly kehti hai "No money was transferred."

items.en: A journal entry posts immediately: Debit Salary Expense, Credit Accounts Payable, for the full total.
items.hi: Ek journal entry immediately post hoti hai: Debit Salary Expense, Credit Accounts Payable, full total ke liye.

items.en: This means payroll becomes a liability (not yet paid), recorded as an expense.
items.hi: Matlab payroll ek liability ban jaata hai (abhi pay nahi hua), expense ke roop mein record hota hai.

example.en: ON_ROLL example: November 2026, calendar days=30. Ramesh (ON_ROLL, monthly rate TSh500,000): 20 days PRESENT, 4 HALF_DAY, 2 PAID-approved-leave, 2 UNPAID-leave, 2 ABSENT = 30 days, all marked. Units: 40+4+4+0+0=48, payable days=24, amount = 500,000 x 24/30 = TSh400,000. OFF_ROLL example: same month, Fatima (OFF_ROLL, daily wage TSh15,000): 22 PRESENT, 3 HALF_DAY, 5 ABSENT = 30 days. Units=44+3=47, payable days=23.5, amount = 15,000x23.5 = TSh352,500. On Finalize, branch November total = 400,000 + 352,500 + other employees, posted as a single journal entry.
example.hi: ON_ROLL example: November 2026, calendar days=30. Ramesh (ON_ROLL, monthly rate TSh500,000): 20 din PRESENT, 4 HALF_DAY, 2 PAID-approved-leave, 2 UNPAID-leave, 2 ABSENT = 30 din, sab marked. Units: 40+4+4+0+0=48, payable days=24, amount = 500,000 x 24/30 = TSh400,000. OFF_ROLL example: same month, Fatima (OFF_ROLL, daily wage TSh15,000): 22 PRESENT, 3 HALF_DAY, 5 ABSENT = 30 din. Units=44+3=47, payable days=23.5, amount = 15,000x23.5 = TSh352,500. Finalize par, branch ka November total = 400,000 + 352,500 + aur employees, ek single journal entry ke roop mein post hota hai.

items.summaryEn: Record a branch's specific expense by category and date, with idempotency protection and a void-only correction flow.
items.summaryHi: Branch ka specific expense category aur date ke saath record karo, idempotency protection ke saath aur sirf void se correction hota hai.

items.en: Choose "Date" — must be within that month, bound to the month's 1st and last day (min/max).
items.hi: "Date" choose karo — us month ke andar hona chahiye, month ke 1st aur last day se bound (min/max).

items.en: Choose "Category": RENT / UTILITIES / MARKETING / OTHER.
items.hi: "Category" choose karo: RENT / UTILITIES / MARKETING / OTHER.

items.en: "Subcategory" is optional free text, max 80 characters.
items.hi: "Subcategory" optional free text hai, max 80 characters.

items.en: "Amount" must be between 0.01 and 999,999,999.99, with 2 decimals.
items.hi: "Amount" 0.01 se 999,999,999.99 ke beech hona chahiye, 2 decimals ke saath.

items.en: "Description" is required, min 3 characters, and must contain at least one letter or number — symbols alone are not allowed.
items.hi: "Description" required hai, min 3 characters, aur kam se kam ek letter ya number hona chahiye — sirf symbols allowed nahi.

items.en: "Reference" is required, min 2 characters — like an invoice number.
items.hi: "Reference" required hai, min 2 characters — jaise invoice number.

items.en: "Payment method" can be blank/"Not specified", "Cash from today's shift drawer" (CASH), or "Bank/Card/Other" (NON_CASH).
items.hi: "Payment method" blank/"Not specified", "Cash from today's shift drawer" (CASH), ya "Bank/Card/Other" (NON_CASH) ho sakta hai.

items.en: Click "Save expense" to post.
items.hi: Post karne ke liye "Save expense" click karo.

items.en: If CASH is chosen, this amount reduces the branch's CURRENT open shift's expected-cash-at-close.
items.hi: Agar CASH choose kiya ho, to yeh amount branch ke CURRENT open shift ke expected-cash-at-close ko kam karta hai.

items.en: This needs an active shift to use — the shiftRunId is resolved server-side; the client never sends it directly.
items.hi: Iske liye active shift zaroori hai — shiftRunId server-side resolve hota hai; client isko kabhi directly nahi bhejta.

items.en: When "Save expense" is clicked, the browser generates a unique idempotencyKey and saves it to session-storage FIRST (attempt journal), before sending the request.
items.hi: "Save expense" click karte hi, browser ek unique idempotencyKey generate karta hai aur request bhejne se PEHLE isko session-storage mein save karta hai (attempt journal).

items.en: If the request fails or connection drops (outcome unknown), the UI shows "Outcome unresolved" and the form goes read-only.
items.hi: Agar request fail ho jaaye ya connection drop ho jaaye (outcome unknown), to UI "Outcome unresolved" dikhati hai aur form read-only ho jaata hai.

items.en: The exact same entry can be retried (with the same idempotencyKey), never a new entry, until the old one resolves.
items.hi: Wahi exact entry retry ki ja sakti hai (same idempotencyKey ke saath), kabhi nayi entry nahi, jab tak purani resolve na ho jaaye.

items.en: Server-side requestFingerprint (SHA-256 hash of all fields) with the same idempotencyKey — if fields match it's a safe no-op, if fields mismatch it's rejected ("Idempotency key already used with a different payload").
items.hi: Server-side requestFingerprint (saare fields ka SHA-256 hash) same idempotencyKey ke saath check hota hai — fields match karein to safe no-op, mismatch karein to reject ho jaata hai ("Idempotency key already used with a different payload").

items.en: This ensures a network retry never creates a duplicate expense, and a crash/refresh can confidently retry.
items.hi: Isse network retry se kabhi duplicate expense nahi banta, aur crash/refresh ke baad confidently retry kiya ja sakta hai.

items.en: A posted expense is never edited — a wrong entry must be "Void"ed instead.
items.hi: Posted expense kabhi edit nahi hota — galat entry ko "Void" karna padta hai.

items.en: Click "Void" on the expense row, write a reason (required, min 3 characters), then click "Confirm void".
items.hi: Expense row par "Void" click karo, reason likho (required, min 3 characters), phir "Confirm void" click karo.

items.en: Void only works on POSTED status expenses — cannot void twice ("Expense already voided").
items.hi: Void sirf POSTED status wali expenses par kaam karta hai — do baar void nahi ho sakta ("Expense already voided").

items.en: The original record is never deleted or edited — status becomes VOID with voidReason saved, and the full audit trail remains.
items.hi: Original record kabhi delete ya edit nahi hota — status VOID ho jaata hai voidReason save hone ke saath, aur full audit trail rehta hai.

items.en: Post: Debit [Category Expense Account], Credit Accounts Payable — meaning this is an "expense recognize", not a cash disbursement (cash-outflow has a separate Petty Cash path).
items.hi: Post: Debit [Category Expense Account], Credit Accounts Payable — matlab yeh "expense recognize" hai, cash disbursement nahi (cash-outflow ke liye alag Petty Cash path hai).

items.en: Void: an exact reversal (debit/credit swapped) with a separate EXPENSE_VOID reference type — the original journal row is never touched.
items.hi: Void: exact reversal (debit/credit swap) hota hai, alag EXPENSE_VOID reference type ke saath — original journal row kabhi touch nahi hota.

example.en: 15 Nov 2026, branch "Masaki" posted Rent expense TSh2,000,000, reference "NOV-RENT-INV-004", payment method NON_CASH. Journal: Debit "Rent Expense (5100)" TSh2,000,000, Credit "Accounts Payable (2000)" TSh2,000,000.
